categories.name: Compensation and benefits
categories.description: Flag vague compensation terms, missing bonus or commission structures, clawback provisions on earned compensation, or benefits that can be unilaterally modified.

categories.name: Termination and severance
categories.description: Flag at-will provisions with no severance, short notice periods, termination for cause definitions that are overly broad, or missing severance terms.

categories.name: Non-compete and non-solicit
categories.description: Flag non-compete clauses longer than 12 months or covering broad geographies, non-solicitation of customers or employees for unreasonable periods.

categories.name: Intellectual property assignment
categories.description: Flag assignment of all inventions including those made outside work hours and unrelated to the business, or failure to carve out prior inventions.

categories.name: Confidentiality
categories.description: Flag overly broad confidentiality that prevents discussing working conditions, or confidentiality that survives indefinitely after employment ends.

categories.name: Duties and role
categories.description: Flag vague role descriptions that allow the employer to unilaterally change duties, or 'other duties as assigned' clauses with no limitation.
